verdict.rationale: Persona's Accounts feature aggregates all verifications for a user across sessions via reference ID (persona-docs-10, persona-docs-40), and Connect lets separate Persona organizations share KYC/KYB data via Share Tokens, enabling reuse of a prior verification across products (persona-docs-44). However, the docs describe data sharing/aggregation rather than an explicit documented mechanism for automatically recognizing and skipping a full re-verification run based on a prior passed check. missing for 10: explicit documented re-verification/skip-check workflow, independent/hands-on confirmation that a repeat verification is bypassed using Connect or Accounts.
